2.t: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Knowing

3.t: the Forgiver of sin and Accepter of repentance, the Severe in punishment, and Infinite in bounty. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. To Him ˹alone˺ is the final return
3.tr: Ghaafiriz zambi Wa-qaabilit tawbi shadeedil 'iqaabi zit tawli laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa ilaihil maseer

4.t: None disputes the signs of Allah except the disbelievers, so do not be deceived by their prosperity throughout the land
4.tr: Maa yujaadilu feee Aayaatil laahi illal lazeena kafaroo falaa yaghrurka taqallubuhum fil bilaad

5.t: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ˹other˺ enemy forces afterwards. Every community plotted against its prophet to seize him, and argued in falsehood, ˹hoping˺ to discredit the truth with it. So I seized them. And how ˹horrible˺ was My punishment
5.tr: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw wal-Ahzaabu min ba'dihim Wa-hammat kullu ummatin bi-Rasoolihim li-ya'khuzoohu Wa-jaadaloo bilbaatili li-yud-hidoo bihil haqqa fa-akhaztuhum fa-kaifa kaana 'iqaab

6.t: And so your Lord’s decree has been proven true against the disbelievers—that they will be the inmates of the Fire
6.tr: Wa-kazaalika haqqat Kalimatu Rabbika 'alal lazeena kafarooo annahum Ashaabun Naar

7.t: Those ˹angels˺ who carry the Throne and those around it glorify the praises of their Lord, have faith in Him, and seek forgiveness for the believers, ˹praying:˺ “Our Lord! You encompass everything in ˹Your˺ mercy and knowledge. So forgive those who repent and follow Your Way, and protect them from the torment of the Hellfire
7.tr: Allazeena yahmiloonal 'Arsha Wa-man hawlahoo yusabbihoona bihamdi Rabbihim Wa-yu'minoona bihee Wa-yastaghfiroona lillazeena aamanoo Rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shai'ir rahmatanw Wa-'ilman faghfir lillazeena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka Wa-qihim 'azaabal Jaheem

8.t: Our Lord! Admit them into the Gardens of Eternity which You have promised them, along with the righteous among their parents, spouses, and descendants. You ˹alone˺ are truly the Almighty, All-Wise
8.tr: Rabbannaa Wa-adkhilhum Jannaati 'adninil latee wa'attahum Wa-man salaha min aabaaa'ihim Wa-azwaajihim Wa-zurriyyaatihim; innaka Antal 'Azeezul Hakeem

9.t: And protect them from ˹the consequences of their˺ evil deeds. For whoever You protect from the evil of their deeds on that Day will have been shown Your mercy. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph.”
9.tr: Wa-qihimus saiyi-aat; Wa-man taqis saiyi-aati Yawma'izin faqad rahimtah; Wa-zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem

10.t: Indeed, it will be announced to the disbelievers, “Allah’s contempt for you—as you disbelieved when invited to belief—was far worse than your contempt for one another ˹Today˺.”
10.tr: Innal lazeena kafaroo yunaadawna lamaqtul laahi akbaru mim maqtikum anfusakum iz tud'awna ilal eemaani fatakfuroon

11.t: They will plead, “Our Lord! You made us lifeless twice, and gave us life twice. Now we confess our sins. So is there any way out?”
11.tr: Qaaloo Rabbanaaa amat tanasnataini Wa-ahyaitanas nataini fa'tarafnaa bizunoo-binaa fahal ilaa khuroojim min sabeel

12.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “˹No!˺ This is because when Allah alone was invoked, you ˹staunchly˺ disbelieved. But when others were associated with Him ˹in worship˺, you ˹readily˺ believed. So ˹Today˺ judgment belongs to Allah ˹alone˺—the Most High, All-Great.”
12.tr: Zaalikum bi-annahooo izaa du'iyal laahu wahdahoo kafartum Wa-ien yushrak bihee tu'minoo; falhukmu lillaahil 'Aliyyil Kabeer

13.t: He is the One Who shows you His signs and sends down ˹rain as˺ a provision for you from the sky. ˹But˺ none will be mindful except those who turn ˹to Him˺
13.tr: Huwal lazee yureekum Aayaatihee Wa-yunazzilu lakum minas samaaa'i rizqaa; Wa-maa tatazakkaru illaa maien yuneeb

14.t: So call upon Allah with sincere devotion, even to the dismay of the disbelievers
14.tr: Fad'ul laaha mukhliseena lahud deena Wa-law karihal kaafiroon

15.t: ˹He is˺ Highly Exalted in rank, Lord of the Throne. He sends down the revelation by His command to whoever He wills of His servants to warn ˹all˺ of the Day of Meeting—
15.tr: Rafee'ud darajaati zul 'Arshi yulqir rooha min amrihee 'alaa mai yashaaa'u min 'ibaadihee liyunzira yawmat talaaq

16.t: the Day all will appear ˹before Allah˺. Nothing about them will be hidden from Him. ˹He will ask,˺ “Who does all authority belong to this Day? To Allah—the One, the Supreme
16.tr: Yawma hum baarizoona laa yakhfaa 'alal laahi minhum shai; limanil mulkul Yawma lillaahil Waahidil Qahaar

17.t: Today every soul will be rewarded for what it has done. No injustice Today! Surely Allah is swift in reckoning.”
17.tr: Al-Yawma tujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa kasabat; laa zulmal Yawm; innal laaha saree'ul hisaab

18.t: Warn them ˹O Prophet˺ of the approaching Day when the hearts will jump into the throats, suppressing distress. The wrongdoers will have neither a close friend nor intercessor to be heard
18.tr: Wa-anzirhum yawmal aazifati izil quloobu ladal hanaajiri kaazimeen; maa lizzaalimeena min hameeminw Wa-laa shafee'ien yutaa'

19.t: Allah ˹even˺ knows the sly glances of the eyes and whatever the hearts conceal
19.tr: Ya'lamu khaaa'inatal a'yuni Wa-maa tukhfis sudoor

20.t: And Allah judges with the truth, while those ˹idols˺ they invoke besides Him cannot judge at all. Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing
20.tr: Wallaahu yaqdee bilhaqq, wallazeena yad'oona min doonihee laa yaqdoona bishai'; innal laaha Huwas Samee'ul Baseer

21.t: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those ˹destroyed˺ before them? They were far superior in might and ˹richer in˺ monuments throughout the land. But Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no protector from Allah
21.tr: Awalam yaseeroo fil ardi fa-yanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena kaanoo min qablihim; kaanoo hum ashadda minhum quwwatanw Wa-aasaaran fil ardi fa-akhazahumul laahu bizunoobihim Wa-maa kaana lahum minal laahi minw waaq

22.t: That was because their messengers used to come to them with clear proofs, but they persisted in disbelief. So Allah seized them. Surely He is All-Powerful, severe in punishment
22.tr: Zaalika bi-annahum kaanat taateehim Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati fakafaroo fa-akhazahumul laah; innahoo qawiyyun shadeedul 'iqaab

23.t: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs and compelling proof
23.tr: Wa-laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi-Aayaatinaa Wa-sultaanim mubeen

24.t: to Pharaoh, Hamân, and Korah. But they responded: “Magician! Total liar!”
24.tr: Ilaa Fir'awna Wa-Haamaana Wa-Qaaroona faqaaloo saahirun kazzaab

25.t: Then, when he came to them with the truth from Us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who believe with him and keep their women.” But the plotting of the disbelievers was only in vain
25.tr: Falama jaaa'ahum bil-haqqi min 'indinaa qaaluq tulooo abnaaa'al lazeena aamanoo ma'ahoo wastahyoo nisaaa'ahum; Wa-maa kaidul kaafireena illaa fee dalaal

26.t: And Pharaoh said, “Let me kill Moses, and let him call upon his Lord! I truly fear that he may change your traditions or cause mischief in the land.”
26.tr: Wa-qaala Fir'awnu zarooneee aqtul Moosaa walyad'u Rabbahoo inneee akhaafu ai yubaddila deenakum aw aien yuzhira fil ardil fasaad

27.t: Moses replied, “I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant person who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”
27.tr: Wa-qaala Moosaaaa innee 'uztu bi-Rabbee Wa-Rabbikum min kulli mutakabbiril laayu'minu bi Yawmil Hisaab

28.t: A believing man from Pharaoh’s people, who was hiding his faith, argued, “Will you kill a man ˹only˺ for saying: ‘My Lord is Allah,’ while he has in fact come to you with clear proofs from your Lord? If he is a liar, it will be to his own loss. But if he is truthful, then you will be afflicted with some of what he is threatening you with. Surely Allah does not guide whoever is a transgressor, a total liar
28.tr: Wa-qaala rajulum mu'minummin Aali Fir'awna yaktumu eemaanahooo ataqtuloona rajulan aien yaqoola Rabbi-yal laahu Wa-qad jaaa'akum bil baiyinaati mir Rabbikum Wa-iny yaku kaaziban fa'alaihi kazibuh Wa-ien yaku saadiqaien yasibkum ba'dul lazee ya'idukum innal laaha laa yahdee man huwa musrifun kazzaab

29.t: O my people! Authority belongs to you today, reigning supreme in the land. But who would help us against the torment of Allah, if it were to befall us?” Pharaoh assured ˹his people˺, “I am telling you only what I believe, and I am leading you only to the way of guidance.”
29.tr: Yaa-qawmi lakumul mulkul yawma zaahireena fil ardi famaien yansurunaa mim baasil laahi in jaaa'anaa; qaala Fir'awnu maaa ureekum illaa maaa araa Wa-maaa ahdeekum illaa sabeelar Rashaad

30.t: And the man who believed cautioned, “O my people! I truly fear for you the doom of ˹earlier˺ enemy forces—
30.tr: Wa-qaalal lazee aamana yaa-qawmi inneee akhaafu 'alaikum misla yawmil Ahzaab

31.t: like the fate of the people of Noah, ’Ȃd, Thamûd, and those after them. For Allah would never will to wrong ˹His˺ servants
31.tr: Misla daabi qawmi Noohinw Wa-'aadinw Wa-Samooda wallazeena mim ba'dihim; Wa-mal laahu yureedu zulmal lil'ibaad

32.t: O my people! I truly fear for you the Day all will be crying out ˹to each other˺—

33.t: the Day you will ˹try in vain to˺ turn your backs and run away, with no one to protect you from Allah. And whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide
33.tr: Yawma tuwalloona mud-bireena maa lakum minal laahi min 'aasim; Wa-maien yudlilil laahu famaa lahoo min haad

34.t: Joseph already came to you earlier with clear proofs, yet you never ceased to doubt what he came to you with. When he died you said, ‘Allah will never send a messenger after him.’ This is how Allah leaves every transgressor and doubter to stray—
34.tr: Wa-laqad jaaa'akum Yoosufu min qablu bil-baiyyinaati famaa ziltum fee shakkim mimaa jaaa'akum bihee hattaaa izaa halaka qultum laien yab-asal laahu mim ba'dihee Rasoolaa; kazaalika yudillul laahu man huwa Musrifum murtaab

35.t: those who dispute Allah’s signs with no proof given to them. How despicable is that for Allah and the believers! This is how Allah seals the heart of every arrogant tyrant.”
35.tr: Allazeena yujaadiloona feee Aaayaatil laahi bighairi sultaanin ataahum kabura maqtan 'indal laahi Wa-'indal lazeena aamanoo; kazaalika yatbahul laahu 'alaa kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbaar

36.t: Pharaoh ordered, “O Hamân! Build me a high tower so I may reach the pathways
36.tr: Wa-qaala Fir'awnu yaa Haamaanub-ni lee sarhal la'alleee ablughul asbaab

37.t: leading up to the heavens and look for the God of Moses, although I am sure he is a liar.” And so Pharaoh’s evil deeds were made so appealing to him that he was hindered from the ˹Right˺ Way. But the plotting of Pharaoh was only in vain
37.tr: Asbaabas samaawaati faattali'a ilaaa ilaahi Moosaa Wa-innee la-azunnuhoo kaazibaa; Wa-kazaalika zuyyina li-Fir'awna sooo'u 'amalihee Wa-sudda 'anis sabeel; Wa-maa kaidu Fir'awna illaa fee tabaab

38.t: And the man who believed urged, “O my people! Follow me, ˹and˺ I will lead you to the Way of Guidance
38.tr: Wa-qaalal lazeee aamana yaa-qawmit tabi'ooni ahdikum sabeelar rashaad

39.t: O my people! This worldly life is only ˹a fleeting˺ enjoyment, whereas the Hereafter is truly the home of settlement
39.tr: Yaa-qawmi innamaa haazihil hayaatud dunyaa mataa'unw Wa-innal Aakhirata hiya daarul qaraar

40.t: Whoever does an evil deed will only be paid back with its equivalent. And whoever does good, whether male or female, and is a believer, they will enter Paradise, where they will be provided for without limit
40.tr: Man 'amila saiyi'atan falaa yujzaaa illaa mislahaa Wa-man 'amila saaliham min zakarin aw unsaa Wa-huwa mu'minun fa-ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal Jannata yurzaqoona feehaa bighairi hisaab

41.t: O my people! How is it that I invite you to salvation, while you invite me to the Fire
41.tr: Wa-yaa-qawmi maa leee ad'ookum ilan najaati Wa-tad'oonaneee ilan Naar

42.t: You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him what I have no knowledge of, while I invite you to the Almighty, Most Forgiving
42.tr: Tad'oonanee li-akfura billaahi Wa-ushrika bihee maa laisa lee bihee 'ilmunw Wa-ana ad'ookum ilal 'Azeezil Ghaffaar

43.t: There is no doubt that whatever ˹idols˺ you invite me to ˹worship˺ are not worthy to be invoked either in this world or the Hereafter. ˹Undoubtedly,˺ our return is to Allah, and the transgressors will be the inmates of the Fire
43.tr: Laa jarama annamaa tad'oonanee ilaihi laisa lahoo da'watun fid dunyaa Wa-laa fil Aakhirati Wa-anna maraddanaaa ilal laahi Wa-annal musrifeena hum Ashaabun Naar

44.t: You will remember what I say to you, and I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is All-Seeing of all ˹His˺ servants.”
44.tr: Fasatazkuroona maaa aqoolu lakum; Wa-ufawwidu amreee ilal laah; innal laaha baseerum bil'ibaad

45.t: So Allah protected him from the evil of their schemes. And Pharaoh’s people were overwhelmed by an evil punishment
45.tr: Fa-waqaahul laahu saiyyiaati maa makaroo Wa-haaqa bi Aali-Fir'awna sooo'ul 'azaab

46.t: they are exposed to the Fire ˹in their graves˺ morning and evening. And on the Day the Hour will be established ˹it will be said˺, “Admit Pharaoh’s people into the harshest punishment ˹of Hell˺.”
46.tr: An-Naaru yu'radoona 'alaihaa ghuduwwanw Wa-'ashiyyanw Wa-Yawma taqoomus Saa'aatu adkhilooo Aala Fir'awna ashaddal 'azaab

47.t: ˹Consider the Day˺ when they will dispute in the Fire, and the lowly ˹followers˺ will appeal to the arrogant ˹leaders˺, “We were your ˹dedicated˺ followers, will you then shield us from a portion of the Fire?”
47.tr: Wa-iz yatahaaajjoona fin Naari fa-yaqoolud du'afaaa'u lillazeenas takbarooo innaa kunnaa lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnoona annaa naseebam minan Naar

48.t: The arrogant will say, “We are all in it! ˹For˺ Allah has already passed judgment over ˹His˺ servants.”
48.tr: Qaalal lazeenas takbarooo innaa kullun feehaaa innal laaha qad hakama baynal 'ibaad

49.t: And those in the Fire will cry out to the keepers of Hell, “Pray to your Lord to lighten the torment for us ˹even˺ for one day!”
49.tr: Wa-qaalal lazeena fin Naari likhazanati Jahannamad 'oo Rabbakum yukhaffif 'annaa yawmam minal 'azaab

50.t: The keepers will reply, “Did your messengers not ˹constantly˺ come to you with clear proofs?” They will say, “Yes ˹they did˺.” The keepers will say, “Then pray! Though the prayer of the disbelievers is only in vain.”
50.tr: Qaalooo awalam taku taateekum Rusulukum bilbaiyinaati qaaloo balaa' qaaloo fad'oo; Wa-maa du'aaa'ul kaafireena illaa fee dalaal

51.t: We certainly help Our messengers and the believers, ˹both˺ in this worldly life and on the Day the witnesses will stand forth ˹for testimony˺—
51.tr: Innaa lanansuru Rusulanaa wallazeena aamanoo fil hayaatid dunyaa Wa-Yawma yaqoomul ashhaad

52.t: the Day the wrongdoers’ excuses will be of no benefit to them. They will be condemned, and will have the worst outcome
52.tr: Yawma laa yanfa'uz zaalimeena ma'ziratuhum Wa-lahumul la'natu Wa-lahum soooud daar

53.t: And indeed, We gave Moses ˹true˺ guidance, and made the Children of Israel inherit the Scripture—
53.tr: Wa-laqad aatainaa Moosal hudaa Wa-awrasnaa Baneee Israaa-'eelal Kitaab

54.t: a guide and a reminder to people of reason

55.t: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺, ˹for˺ Allah’s promise is certainly true. Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings. And glorify the praises of your Lord morning and evening
55.tr: Fasbir inna wa'dal laahi haqqunw wastaghfir lizambika Wa-sabbih bihamdi Rabbika bil'ashiyyi wal-ibkaar

56.t: Surely those who dispute Allah’s signs—with no proof given to them—have nothing in their hearts but greed for dominance, which they will never attain. So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He alone is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing
56.tr: Innal lazeena yujaadi-loona feee Aayaatil laahi bighairi sultaanin ataahum in fee sudoorihim illaa kibrum maa hum bibaaligheeh; fasta'iz billaahi innahoo Huwas Samee'ul Baseer

57.t: The creation of the heavens and the earth is certainly greater than the re-creation of humankind, but most people do not know
57.tr: Lakhalqus samaawaati wal-ardi akbaru min khalqin naasi Wa-laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon

58.t: Those blind ˹to the truth˺ and those who can see are not equal, nor are those who believe and do good ˹equal˺ to those who do evil. Yet you are hardly mindful
58.tr: Wa-maa yastawil a'maa walbaseeru wallazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati Wa-lal museee'; qaleelam maa tatazakkaroon

59.t: The Hour is certainly coming, there is no doubt about it. But most people do not believe
59.tr: Innas Saa'ata la-aatiyatul laa raiba feehaa Wa-laakinna aksaran naasi laa yu'minoon

60.t: Your Lord has proclaimed, “Call upon Me, I will respond to you. Surely those who are too proud to worship Me will enter Hell, fully humbled.”
60.tr: Wa-qaala Rabbukumud 'ooneee astajib lakum; innal lazeena yastakbiroona an 'ibaadatee sa-yadkhuloona jahannama daakhireen

61.t: It is Allah Who has made the night for you to rest in and the day bright. Surely Allah is ever Bountiful to humanity, but most people are ungrateful
61.tr: Allaahul lazee ja'ala lakumul laila littaskunoo feehi wannahaara mubsiraa; innal laaha lazoo fadlin 'alan naasi Wa-laakinna aksaran naasi laa yashkuroon

62.t: That is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. How can you then be deluded ˹from the truth˺
62.tr: Zaalikumul laahu Rabbukum khaaliqu kulli shai'in; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fa-annaa tu'fakoon

63.t: This is how those who used to reject Allah’s signs were ˹also˺ deluded
63.tr: Kazaalika yu'fakul lazeena kaanoo bi-Aayaatil laahi yajhadoon

64.t: It is Allah Who made the earth a place of settlement for you and the sky a canopy. He shaped you ˹in the womb˺, perfecting your form. And He has provided you with what is good and lawful. That is Allah—your Lord. So Blessed is Allah, Lord of all worlds
64.tr: Allaahul lazee ja'ala lakumul arda qaraaranw wassa-maaa'a binaaa'anw Wa-sawwarakum fa-ahsana suwarakum Wa-razaqakum minat taiyibaat; zaalikumul laahu Rabbukum fatabaarakal laahu Rabbul 'aalameen

65.t: He is the Ever-Living. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. So call upon Him with sincere devotion, ˹saying,˺ “All praise is for Allah—Lord of all worlds.”
65.tr: Huwal Hayyu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fad'oohu mukh liseena lahudeen; alhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen

66.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I have been forbidden to worship those ˹idols˺ you worship besides Allah, since clear proofs have come to me from my Lord. And I have been commanded to ˹fully˺ submit to the Lord of all worlds.”
66.tr: Qul innee nuheetu an a'budal lazeena tad'oona min doonil laahi lammaa jaaa'a-niyal baiyinaatu mir Rabbee Wa-umirtu an uslima li-Rabbil 'aalameen

67.t: He is the One Who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then ˹developed you into˺ a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He brings you forth as infants, so that you may reach your prime, and become old—though some of you ˹may˺ die sooner—reaching an appointed time, so perhaps you may understand ˹Allah’s power˺
67.tr: Huwal lazee khalaqakum min turaabin summa min nutfatin summa min 'alaqatin summa yukhrijukum tiflan summa litablughooo ashuddakum summa litakoonoo shuyookhaa; Wa-minkum maien yutawaffaa min qablu Wa-litablughooo ajalam musam-manw wa-la'allakum ta'qiloon

68.t: He is the One Who gives life and causes death. When He decrees a matter, He simply tells it, “Be!” And it is
68.tr: Huwal lazee yuhyee Wa-yumeetu fa-izaa qadaaa amran fa-innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa-yakoon

69.t: Have you not seen how those who dispute Allah’s signs are turned away
69.tr: Alam tara ilal lazeena yujaadiloona feee Aayaatil laahi annaa yusrafoon

70.t: ˹They are˺ the ones who reject this Book and all ˹scriptures˺ We sent Our messengers with. So they will know ˹the consequences˺
70.tr: Allazeena kazzaboo bil-Kitaabi Wa-bimaa arsalnaa bihee Rusulanaa fasawfa ya'lamoon

71.t: when shackles will be around their necks and chains ˹on their legs˺. They will be dragged
71.tr: Izil aghlaalu feee a'naaqi-him wassalaasilu yushaboon

72.t: through boiling water, then burned in the Fire ˹as fuel˺
72.tr: Fil hameemi summa fin Naari Yasjaroon

73.t: Then they will be asked, “Where are those ˹idols˺ you used to associate
73.tr: Summaa qeela lahum ayna maa kuntum tushrikoon

74.t: with Allah?” They will cry, “They have ˹all˺ failed us. In fact, we did not invoke anything ˹real˺ before.” This is how Allah leaves the disbelievers to stray
74.tr: Min doonil laahi qaaloo dalloo 'annaa bal lam nakun nad'oo min qablu shai'aa; kazaalika yudillul laahul kaafireen

75.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “This ˹punishment˺ is for being prideful on earth unjustly and for acting arrogantly
75.tr: Zaalikum bimaa kuntum tafrahoona fil ardi bighairil haqqi Wa-bimaa kuntum tamrahoon

76.t: Enter the gates of Hell, to stay there forever. What an evil home for the arrogant!”
76.tr: Udkhulooo abwaaba Jahannama khaalideena feehaa fabi'sa maswal mutakabbireen

77.t: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺. Surely Allah’s promise is true. Whether We show you some of what We threaten them with, or cause you to die ˹before that˺, to Us they will ˹all˺ be returned
77.tr: Fasbir inna wa'dal laahi haqq; fa-immaa nuriyannak ba'dal lazee na'i-duhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilainaa yurja'oon

78.t: We already sent messengers before you. We have told you the stories of some of them, while others We have not. It was not for any messenger to bring a sign without Allah’s permission. But when Allah’s decree comes, judgment will be passed with fairness, and the people of falsehood will then be in ˹total˺ loss
78.tr: Wa-laqad arsalnaa Rusulam min qablika minhum man qasasnaa 'alaika Wa-minhum mal lam naqsus 'alaik; Wa-maa kaana li-Rasoolin any yaatiya bi-Aayatin illaa bi-iznil laah; fa-izaa jaaa'a amrul laahi qudiya bilhaqqi Wa-khasira hunaalikal mubtiloon

79.t: It is Allah Who made cattle for you so that you may ride some and eat others
79.tr: Allaahul lazee ja'ala lakumul an'aama litarkaboo minhaa Wa-minhaa taakuloon

80.t: Also, you find in them ˹other˺ benefits. And by means of them you may reach destinations you desire. And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships
80.tr: Wa-lakum feehaa manaafi'u Wa-litablughoo 'alaihaa haajatan fee sudoorikum Wa-'alaihaa Wa-'alal fulki tuhmaloon

81.t: And He shows you His signs. Now which of Allah’s signs will you deny
81.tr: Wa-yureekum Aayaatihee fa-ayya Aayaatil laahi tunkiroon

82.t: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those who were ˹destroyed˺ before them? They were far superior in might and ˹richer in˺ monuments throughout the land, but their ˹worldly˺ gains were of no benefit to them
82.tr: Afalam yaseeroo fil ardi fa-yanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qablihim; kaanoo aksara minhum Wa-ashadda quwwatanw Wa-aasaaran fil ardi famaaa aghnaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon

83.t: When their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they were prideful in whatever ˹worldly˺ knowledge they had, and were ˹ultimately˺ overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule
83.tr: Falammaa jaaa'at-hum Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati farihoo bimaa 'indahum minal 'ilmi Wa-haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

84.t: When they saw Our punishment, they cried, “˹Now˺ we believe in Allah alone and reject what we had been associating with Him!”
84.tr: Falammaa ra-aw baasanaa qaalooo aamannaa billaahi wahdahoo Wa-kafarnaa bimaa kunnaa bihee mushrikeen

85.t: But their faith was of no benefit to them when they saw Our torment. This has ˹always˺ been Allah’s way ˹of dealing˺ with His ˹wicked˺ servants. Then and there the disbelievers were in ˹total˺ loss
85.tr: Falam yaku tanfa-'uhum eemaanuhum lammaa ra-aw ba'sana sunnatal laahil latee qad khalat fee 'ibaadihee Wa-khasira hunaalikal kaafiroon
